deviations: Rows 11-12 keep row 10's request, a tighten typed in ticks (600 → 63,950.0, L392): the field reads 600 with 'ticks' selected and §3.4 L189's recompute line under it, verbatim; its risk sits inside that line, so §4.1's separate price-mode read-out (sltp.readout, '= 1 R · excl. fees', L331) is not repeated, and the drawn risk carries no 'excl. fees' caption (§4.2 L365, G-17: a copy gap); CMP-130's slippage line (L332) stays.

Local helper pending_stop_row() (gen_05.py): the held stop row in row 10's pending form (L392), which the kit's stop_row() does not draw — the state mark (the hourglass and 'Moving…', sltp.moving) in the label line, the field, the unit switch and the trigger select read-only ('inputs read-only'), the field's read-outs under it, the state's line (static text in the stop row's description, §4.4 L418-419) and §4.1's owner loosen slot (rows 10-14 name no change to it). Rows 11-13 draw the line, then the slot, in board 04's row 10 order; row 14 draws the slot first (loosen_first), so the line sits directly above its 'Retry' and 'Cancel level 4' and the visual order follows §4.4's Tab order (L417-420: … 'Loosen stop…' → 'Retry' → 'Cancel level 4').
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
The busy state (CMP-001 loading, aria-busy; §3.6 L251-252) is the control's own look with the 'pending' glyph leading its busy label; E30-D02 D17's in-button progress bar is hi-fi.

Focus 'unchanged' (rows 11-13, L393-395) is drawn as the ring on the busy Apply ('Applying…', aria-busy), where row 10 leaves it ('stays on Apply', L392); pending_footer() wraps the kit's busy() button in its ring() (the kit's button() has no busy-and-focused state).
A focus ring is a 2 px inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs padding, so it sits 2 px off the control and adds 4 px on each side to the layout (CMP-039).
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.

Rows 13-14 are the §5.1 ladder's position (levels 1-2 filled: long 0.351 BTC at avg entry 63,873.9, L466; L588): the header carries 0.351, the read-out shows 'entry 63,873.9' only, and the stop row draws no recompute, risk or slippage read-out; the take-profit ladder, trailing and breakeven rows are not drawn — the spec gives none of these figures for this position, and a board never computes one (build notes; header L18-22). §4.1's TP rungs belong to the 0.250 position.

Row 13 draws row 10's pair of pending lines (L392): sl.tighten.pending.ladder, then sltp.pending.held filled with the position's held stop, 'Held by Bybit now: 62,426.0.' (§3.8 L292; 62,426.0 from L395). Row 13's Copy cell (L395) lists only sl.tighten.pending.ladder, which replaces sl.tighten.pending, row 10's first line, not its second (D01:120), and names 62,476.0 only; D3 (L125), §3.2 L167, H1 (L793) and §14 L925 want every pending frame to name the stop Bybit holds (spec carry: review question 1).

Row 14: sl.tighten.partial.ladder's trailing 'Retry · Cancel level 4' (L396) is drawn as the two controls §4.4 L420 names ('Retry' → 'Cancel level 4' follow the stop row: the kit's after_stop slot), the sentence before it verbatim as the line. The line is the stop row's last part, under §4.1's owner loosen slot (pending_stop_row(loosen_first=True)), so it reads straight into its two controls, in §4.4's Tab order (L417-420).

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
